function.name: confirm_booking
function.description: Only after the caller clearly says yes to the specific window you just offered (from the current proposal): decision=accepted with their actual words. Record declined if they say no. Silence, an unrelated yes, 'yes, but...' or a correction is not agreement. Never call it in the same turn as propose_booking. Success atomically books the appointment and assigns a technician (assigned does not mean en route). After an unconfirmed response call get_booking_status before retrying the SAME proposal; never create a duplicate. A booking made earlier in a call that then reports a safety emergency is put on hold for dispatcher review (status on_hold): never call it confirmed. Any result that isn't a success has status, missing, expected (exact saved values to echo) and a one-sentence hint: follow the hint and never speak past it as if it worked. stop_retrying means stop calling this tool: record request_followup(reason=technical_issue) and tell the caller the team will follow up.

bot_say.description: Spoken to the caller while this runs: one brief, natural acknowledgment (2-6 words) that fits this moment, e.g. "Great, booking that now", "Okay, locking that in". Vary it from your last one. In the caller's current language. No trailing punctuation.

contents.text: Thanks for waiting, I'm still working on it.
Gracias por esperar, sigo trabajando en ello.
